{handwritten card, English, fountain-pen ink; two recipes, one on each half, separated by a line}
BRAN MUFFINS (Aunt Margaret)
1 c. natural bran
1 c. buttermilk {"butter" smudged; could be "sour milk"}
1/3 c. oleo, melted
1/2 c. brown sugar
1 egg
1 c. flour
1 t. soda
1 t. b. powder
1/2 t. salt
1/2 c. raisins (or dates)
Soak bran in buttermilk 10 min. Beat in oleo, sugar, egg.
Stir in dry ingred. just to moisten, fold in raisins.
Fill greased tins 2/3 full. 375 — 20-25 min. Makes 12.
--------------------------------------------------------------
DATE SQUARES
Filling: 1 lb. dates, chopped, 1 c. water, 1/2 c. sugar {"1/2" may be "1/3"}
  cook till thick, add a squeeze of lemon
Crumbs: 1 1/2 c. rolled oats
        1 1/2 "  flour {ditto under "c."}
        1 c. brown sugar
        3/4 c. butter
        1/2 t. soda, pinch salt
Press half the crumbs in 8x8 pan, spread filling, top with rest.
Bake 350 about 30 min. Cut when cool.
